tonight.headline: One claim left, and it closes at 01:00 tonight
body: Bad news first: your only defence, the Vikings, is still in the lineup on a bye at 0.0, and the claim that fixes it processes at 01:00 tonight Mexico City time. Nothing after this brief arrives in time.

Everything else is done. Coker and McLaurin replaced Jefferson and Gordon at 13:46 UTC, so the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 119.3 against Bok-aneers' 79.1 — they carry three byes of their own (Gibbs, Chase Brown, the Bengals' defence).

case.label: Why the claim is the whole week
case.body: A defence projects about 8 points here; the slot is the only zero left in your lineup, and ESPN's 73% is computed with it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Losing the Ravens claim to Panda Attack, the one team ahead of you in the order — the Chiefs claim then fires. Or Coker inactive at 09:30 Sunday, when Kamara takes the flex.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Waivers clear Wed 01:00 Mexico City — the window closes overnight
doFirst.title: Claim the Ravens' defence; drop the Vikings'
doFirst.subtitle: Minnesota are on bye and you carry no other defence. Put in the Chiefs as a second claim with the same drop.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Vikings D/ST is your only defence and Minnesota are off in Week 6: 0.0 in the lineup.

case.label: The pick
case.body: Ravens 8.2, Chiefs 8.1 in this league's projection — a coin flip, so the projection decides: Baltimore first. RotoWire puts both in its top tier (Chiefs 1st, Ravens 3rd, 13 Oct); Cleveland's implied total is 18.5 (CBS, 13 Oct) and Lamar Jackson's ankle does not touch a defence.

case.label: The drop
case.body: The Vikings are 87% rostered, so this disagrees with the market on the record: a defence on bye scores nothing, defences are streamed by policy, and dropping a skill player for a one-week defence would cost more. AVIATO are 2nd in the order; only Panda Attack are ahead.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Ravens score less in Week 6 than the Chiefs or the Patriots (7.7), the two you could have had instead (archive).

action.label: Claim Ravens D/ST · drop Vikings D/ST

whatWentWrong.title: Your defence is still on bye
whatWentWrong.lead: The two receiver swaps went in this morning; the defence did not, because it needs a claim.

case.label: The cost
case.body: 0.0 in a slot the wire fills for about 8. It is the only gap between the lineup as set and the best lineup you can field.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The claim above processing. If it fails to Panda Attack, the Chiefs claim fires; if both fail, the Patriots or Colts are free agents on Wednesday morning.

worthALook.name: Chiefs D/ST
worthALook.lead: Your second claim, same drop. RotoWire's first-ranked defence this week.

case.label: The case
case.body: Implied total 25.0 against the Chargers' 17.0; RotoWire calls Los Angeles 'the NFL's most injured offense' (13 Oct). McConkey played no offensive snaps in Week 5 and Johnston missed it (Yahoo, 13 Oct).

case.label: Why second
case.body: 8.1 against the Ravens' 8.2: a coin flip, which goes to the projection.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tonight, as the second claim behind the Ravens with the Vikings as the drop. It fires only if Panda Attack take Baltimore.

worthALook.name: Jameis Winston
worthALook.lead: Buffalo are on bye in Week 7 and you carry one quarterback. Winston is the screen's cheapest answer.

case.label: The player
case.body: Third straight start for the injured Dart; led a 14-point fourth-quarter comeback in the tie with Washington (Giants.com, 12 Oct). NFL.com calls him 'playable in a pinch'.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Allen starts Week 6. A Week 7 quarterback is next Tuesday's claim, made with Week 7's projections.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Dart's IR is season-long, so the job is his; a benching for turnovers would end it.

worthALook.name: Woody Marks
worthALook.lead: Houston's lead back while Montgomery is out — and Tuten is on bye in Week 7.

case.label: The role
case.body: 56 of 66 snaps after Montgomery left; Dare Ogunbowale the only other healthy back (RotoWire, 13 Oct). Footballguys expects Montgomery to miss Weeks 6 and 7, then Houston's Week 8 bye.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: 10.8 this week, below McLaurin 12.4 and Coker 13.9 for the flex. No seat opens until a receiver is out.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Coker downgraded on Wednesday or Thursday: add Marks as a free agent after claims run, dropping Addison.
